verdict.rationale: The only AI-related evidence is a homepage line about 'AI-powered suggestions' used to 'hook your audience' alongside dynamic content. That reads as audience-facing personalization or recommendations, not AI drafting or refining subject lines and email copy from a brief inside the composer. Nothing in the pack documents an in-composer AI writing assistant.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can have the platform's built-in AI draft or refine subject lines and email copy from a brief, inside the composer
